result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers find the same core problems and recommend a similar Nunito-based fix with preconnect and display=swap. A is tighter and makes no factual slips. B labels the Comic Neue URL a 'bug' and in the same breath says it's fine, which is padding. B keeps more friendly personality by pairing Fredoka with Nunito and rightly notes that fonts may not be the only cause of the slowness, but A's precision gives it a narrow edge. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers cover nearly the same ground: too many unrelated families, Lobster as body text at 13px with tight leading, hairline weights, the @import chain, unused weights and display=block. Answer A's replacement uses Fredoka plus Nunito, which keeps a bit more kid-friendly personality. However, A contradicts itself with a 'URL has a bug' point and then says the URL is syntactically fine. B is tighter and more accurate on fallbacks, including Courier New and Lobster's cursive fallback, and notes that display=block with a Lobster body can leave the whole page blank, so B wins narrowly.
